scripts.build:contracts: npm run generate && tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && node tools/build.mjs
scripts.build:local: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @better-loop/privacy && npm run build --workspace @better-loop/evidence && npm run build --workspace @better-loop/measurement && npm run build --workspace @better-loop/discovery && npm run build --workspace @better-loop/handoff && node tools/build-local.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace @better-loop/measurement && npm run typecheck --workspace @better-loop/evidence && npm run typecheck --workspace @better-loop/discovery && npm run typecheck --workspace @better-loop/handoff
scripts.check:seed: python3 tools/validate_context.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p '*_test.py'
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:privacy && npm run test:measurement && npm run test:extensions && npm run check:seed && npm run test:parity && npm run check:artifact
scripts.pack:contracts: npm run build:contracts && npm pack --workspace @better-loop/contracts --pack-destination artifacts
scripts.test:extensions: npm test --workspace @better-loop/evidence && npm test --workspace @better-loop/discovery && npm test --workspace @better-loop/handoff
